sentences.text:
This appeal is by the injured/claimant seeking enhancement of compensation, being aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 23.2.2021 in MVC No.976/2018 by the III Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Ranebennur (for short, 'Tribunal').
Shri Mahammad Jabiulla W/O Mahammeed ... vs Shri Mahammad Raqulla S/O. Abdul ... on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61856134/
2

entities.text: III Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Ranebennur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the appellant/claimant submits that the Tribunals has committed an error in awarding the total compensation by calculating compensation as per the provisions of the Employees' Compensation Act, 1923 and the appellant/claimant is entitled to compensation as per the provisions of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988.
He further submits that the disability assessed by the Tribunal is at 10%, which is on the lower side and seeks to re-assess the disability.
3. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent No.2/Insurance Company supports the impugned judgment and award of the Tribunal and seeks to dismiss the appeal.
4. I have heard the arguments of learned counsel for the appellant/injured and respondent No.2/Insurance Company and also perused the material available on record.
It is not in dispute that the appellant met with road accident on 7.3.2017 and sustained fracture of L4 & L5 vertebra bone.
Taking note of the same, the Tribunal has rightly assessed the disability at 10%, which is unaltered.

6. This Court notionally assesses the income of the appellant/claimant at Rs.10,250/- p.m. by placing reliance on the notional income chart prepared by KSLSA and hence, the loss of future income due to disability would be as under:
10,250 x 12 x 14 x10%= Rs.1,72,200/-
7.

In all, the appellant/claimant shall be entitled to modified compensation under the following heads:
 HEADS AMOUNT  (in Rs.)
Towards pain and suffering 40,000/-
Towards Medical expenses 10,000/-
Food, nourishment and attendant charges 15,000/-
Loss of future earnings due to disability 1,72,200/-
Loss of amenities 30,000/-
Loss of income during laid-up period 30,750/-
 Total 2,97,950/-
 NC: 2024:KHC-D:6365  8.
Thus, the claimant shall be entitled to total compensation of Rs.2,97,950/- as against Rs.1,04,800/- awarded by the Tribunal.
Shri Mahammad Jabiulla W/O Mahammeed ... vs Shri Mahammad Raqulla S/O. Abdul ...
on 15 April, 2024

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61856134/
3 9.

In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER a) Appeal stands allowed in part.
b) The impugned judgment and award of the Tribunal is modified to an extent that the claimant would be entitled to total compensation of Rs.2,97,950/- as against Rs.1,04,800/- awarded by the Tribunal.
c) The enhanced compensation amount shall carry interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of payment.

d) The Insurance Company shall deposit the enhanced compensation amount with accrued interest before the Tribunal within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.
e) On such deposit, the same shall be released in favour of the appellant/claimant.
NC: 2024:KHC-D:6365 f) Draw modified award accordingly.

Sd/-
JUDGE Vb/-
